title: Agent Pay failure: checkout total exceeds the registered intent
summary: At Level 3 the agent submits a checkout whose total is higher than orderTotalAmount in the registered intent. Mastercard tells merchants to reject it.

steps.label: Checkout with intentId
steps.detail: The agent sends the intent and credentials. The cart now costs more than the consumer approved, for example after a price change.

steps.label: Compare totals
steps.detail: The merchant compares its checkout total with orderTotalAmount and its own srcDpaId with the merchant in the intent.

steps.label: Reject checkout
steps.detail: No authorization is sent. For a DEFERRED order the guide suggests requiring the agent to get explicit consumer confirmation instead.
